title: Neutral assignment-scope description instead of core reads of Scopes internals
question: After P2, core still reads Scopes module internals through the interim Scopes\Internal\ScopeConfiguration (filter metadata, same-alias merge, ownerless/resolvesByQuery facts, module options) and imports BaseAssignmentScope, RoleBindings and ConfigurableAssignmentScopeDefinition (I2). The reference does not say how core learns these facts once the module is separate. How is the gap closed?

options.text: Neutral description in core: a new optional capability Contracts\Scopes\DescribesAssignmentScope::description(): Context\AssignmentScopeDescription (opaque evaluator-applied components, label, directory, tenantOwner, resolvesThroughQuery), implemented by the module's BaseAssignmentScope; same-alias definitions must be identical or conflict (no filter merge); the module validates its own options in ScopesPlugin::register(); core names no module type.

Keep scope settings in core: amend the type map so ConfigurableAssignmentScopeDefinition and AssignmentScopeSettings stay core contracts read directly by core; ownerless/resolvesByQuery still need a core interface.

context: P3 design session 2026-10-13. Evidence: log deviations of P2.7, P2.8 and P2.10 ('P3 must move them behind a contract when it splits ScopeConfiguration'); tests/Arch/Allowlists/i2.json entries BatchInputs→BaseAssignmentScope and SchemaBuilder→{RoleBindings, ConfigurableAssignmentScopeDefinition}; core readers PanelCompiler, PanelFingerprint, RoleCompiler, ResourceContextMapping, SchemaBuilder.
decision: A — Neutral description in core: a new optional capability Contracts\Scopes\DescribesAssignmentScope::description(): Context\AssignmentScopeDescription (opaque evaluator-applied components, label, directory, tenantOwner, resolvesThroughQuery), implemented by the module's BaseAssignmentScope; same-alias definitions must be identical or conflict (no filter merge); the module validates its own options in ScopesPlugin::register(); core names no module type.
consequences: knowledge/contracts gains the two types above (signatures in knowledge/p3-execution#scope-description); knowledge/type-map gains them as new / P3 rows (core); Scopes\Internal\ScopeConfiguration loses checkOptions/ownerless/resolvesByQuery/directory/membership/adapters/merge/sameStructure/filterMetadata as core entry points.
Behavior change (migration line): two contributions of one alias with different filters/label/directory now conflict instead of being merged.
AssignmentScopeBindingSchema::$exactSupport means 'a queryable model-backed definition'; adapter-backed external types report false (no current reader besides tests).
Boot-time container-resolvability errors for scope membership/adapters become doctor errors (scopes.membership) plus fail-closed runtime denial.
i2.json loses the BatchInputs and SchemaBuilder entries; no core file imports AzGuard\Scopes\*.
